text: Mongolia has committed to set a national voluntary LDN target, establish an LDN baseline, and formulate associated measures to achieve LDN.
label: LDN commitment

sources.sourceText:
Mongolia has committed to set a national voluntary LDN target, establish an LDN
baseline, and formulate associated measures to achieve LDN.

text: Reduce GHG emissions from deforestation and forest degradation by 2% by 2020 and 5% by 2030.
label: Reduce forest emissions

sources.sourceText:
Agriculture, Forestry and Other
Land
Uses (AFOLU) targets: Reduce
GHG emissions from
deforestation and forest degradation by 2% by 2020 and 5% by 2030
sources.section: Box. Highlights on Climate Change and Land from Mongolia's Nationally Determined Contributions

text: A comprehensive plan for emission reductions in the livestock sub-sector for implementation between 2020 and 2030.
label: Livestock emissions plan

sources.sourceText:
Agriculture:
A comprehensive plan for emission reductions in the livestock sub-sector for
implementation between 2020 and 2030
sources.section: Box. Highlights on Climate Change and Land from Mongolia's Nationally Determined Contributions

text: Make forests resilient to climate change by improving their productivity and changing their composition and structure.
label: Climate-resilient forests

sources.sourceText:
Sustainable Forest Management: To make forests resilient to climate change by improving their
productivity and changing their composition and structure
sources.section: Box. Highlights on Climate Change and Land from Mongolia's Nationally Determined Contributions

text: Forest area will be increased to 9% by 2030 through reforestation activities; reduce forest degradation rate caused by human activities, fires, insects and diseases; increase efficiency of reforestation actions.
label: Reforestation expansion

sources.sourceText:
Reforestation: Forest area will be increased to 9% by 2030 through reforestation activities; To
reduce forest degradation rate caused by human activities, fires, insects and diseases; To increase
efficiency of reforestation actions; To reduce forest degradation rate
sources.section: Box. Highlights on Climate Change and Land from Mongolia's Nationally Determined Contributions

text: Reduce bare fallow to 30%; introduce crop rotation system with 3-4 routes and 3-5 crops; expand irrigated cropland by 2-2.5 times; increase irrigated cropland, reduce soil water loss and decrease soil carbon emissions.
label: Land and soil management

sources.sourceText:
Land and Soil Management: To reduce bare fallow to 30% ; To introduce crop rotation system with
3-4 routes and 3-5 crops; To expand irrigated cropland by 2- 2.5 times; To increase irrigated
cropland, reduce soil water loss and decrease soil carbon emissions
sources.section: Box. Highlights on Climate Change and Land from Mongolia's Nationally Determined Contributions

text: Reduce rate of pasture degradation; regulate headcounts and types of animals including wild animals to match with pasture carrying capacities; implement sustainable pasture management.
label: Sustainable pasture management

sources.sourceText:
Livestock: Reduce rate of pasture degradation; Regulate headcounts and types of animals including
wild animals to match with pasture carrying capacities; To implement sustainable pasture
management
sources.section: Box. Highlights on Climate Change and Land from Mongolia's Nationally Determined Contributions

text: Enhance and improve early warning and prevention systems for natural disasters.
label: Disaster risk systems

sources.sourceText:
Disaster Risk Management: To enhance and improve early warning and prevention systems for
natural disasters
sources.section: Box. Highlights on Climate Change and Land from Mongolia's Nationally Determined Contributions

text: Combat desertification, restore degraded land and soil, including land affected by desertification, drought and floods, and strive to achieve a land degradation-neutral world by 2030.
label: Achieve LDN by 2030
